items.title: Kushner travels to Berlin for talks on Ukraine settlement
items.summary: US envoy Jared Kushner is reportedly heading to Berlin for discussions with President Volodymyr Zelensky and European political leaders about a possible settlement of the Russia–Ukraine war. The meetings follow previously announced plans for negotiations involving US, Ukrainian and European representatives.

items.title: Russia says military prosthetics waiting lists eliminated
items.summary: Russian Deputy Defence Minister Anna Tsivileva said waiting lists for prosthetic treatment in military hospitals have been eliminated and the average process from injury to discharge has fallen to about three months. She also reported eight hospitals built or modernized in 2026, adding 1,500 beds, and described simplified compensation procedures for wounded service members.

items.title: Spanish police investigate far-right group with alleged Ukraine training links
items.summary: A report about Spain's Núcleo Nacional group says investigators are examining alleged paramilitary training by members in Ukraine and contacts with the Azov brigade, amid an inquiry into a possible armed uprising. A separate analysis reportedly argued the group's activity benefited Russian interests but did not establish Russian financing or operational control.

items.title: Russian Defence Ministry claims drone strikes on Ukrainian equipment
items.summary: Russia's Defence Ministry says drones operated by its Tsentr Group destroyed Ukrainian heavy hexacopters and communications equipment in the Dnipropetrovsk direction. The statement did not provide quantities or a detailed damage assessment.
